Yandex Cloud command-line interface

Usage:
  yc <group|command> [flags...] [args...]
  yc [command]

Groups:
  compute                      Manage Compute Cloud resources
  iam                          Manage access permissions
  managed-kubernetes           Manage Managed Service for Kubernetes

Commands:
  completion                   Generate the completion script
  init                         Initialize the CLI
  version                      Show the version of this CLI

Flags:
      --format string
          Output format: text (default), yaml, json, json-rest
  -h, --help
          Display help for the command

Global Flags:
      --profile string
          Set the custom configuration file
      --debug
          Debug logging
      --no-user-output
          Disable printing user intended output to stderr
